prompt_text:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens and shallow depth of field, with deep blue night tones and warm golden bokeh. A static close-up of a black smartphone held upright in a young man's right hand at night; the phone is centered, its screen facing the camera and filling most of the frame, his thumb resting lightly at the lower edge of the screen and the cuff of a dark blue-gray overshirt visible at his wrist. The screen shows a clean, bright blue-and-white social app. At the top is a solid blue header bar with the white title "SUPER DRY CLUB". Below it, a small square photo shows a silver beer can with a blue top standing on a stone ledge at night. Below the photo is a simple row of five round profile circles with soft, blurred faces, and under them a few plain gray lines and small blue dots instead of words. The only readable text on the screen is "SUPER DRY CLUB"; every other interface element is a simple shape or line. The screen geometry stays stable and the interface does not change or flicker for the whole shot. The cool white light of the screen falls softly on his fingers. Behind the phone, warm city lights across a river glow as soft, round golden bokeh circles against deep blue darkness. There is no other text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Low riverside ambience continues under one subtle, soft phone tap.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads with a soft low pulse and a low, sustained bass note, kept low in volume.
